sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 500. Success value 100. 3x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 500. Deal magic damage (Time) 3 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Applies Field Protect to the allied Field.
-Target: all allies. Applies 50% elevation for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Absolute (increases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 150 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: all allies. Applies Serenity for 150 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
-Target: yourself. Applies Skirmish for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects; [Special] fill your Unison gauge by 3 and recover 5 Cost when using an Ability; [Special] restores CP based on damage dealt. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Savior Element (increases all stats by 120%, increases fire, water, wind, light, dark, time, and star elemental attack by 6, and increases Cost recovery speed by 10) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases maximum Cost by 50 when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 80% for 150 seconds.
Time and Star Defense from Unison Damage +700
